name: Voxel Generation with Diffusion Models
definition: Uses a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) to generate voxelized shapes. The goal is to learn a parameterized Markov chain that generates novel samples after finite time steps.
summary: Voxel Generation with Diffusion Models creates discrete 3D volumetric shapes by training a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model to learn voxelized object distributions, serving as an initial coarse representation for downstream mesh extraction.
